D: The X-Men team up with Magneto to stop a military man's attack on mutants.
P: Serve the snacks when Bobby brings the team home to his parents' place in Boston.
S: Bacon, potato and clam chowder with milk and cream
Bacon, onion and potato softened in butter, clams and milk added and simmered 10 minutes, finished with cream, served in small cups with oyster crackers.
Red and green grapes frozen solid, served straight from the freezer
Red and green grapes washed, dried and frozen on a tray for 3 hours, served straight from the freezer like little ice marbles.
Boston baked beans on buttered toast
Nightcrawler's hideout in an old Boston church

Navy beans slow cooked with molasses, mustard, onion and bacon at 150C for three hours, piled onto hot buttered toast. Soak 400g dried navy beans overnight, then simmer 45 minutes until just tender and drain, keeping 500ml of the water. Fry 200g diced bacon and 1 diced onion in a heavy pot. Stir in 80ml molasses, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp Dijon mustard, 2 tbsp tomato paste, the beans and the reserved water. Cover and bake at 150C for 3 hours, stirring now and then and adding water if dry. Pile onto thick buttered toast.
M: Xavier school roast chicken and veg
dinner at Xavier's school for gifted youngsters

Chicken rubbed with butter and thyme, roasted at 200C for 75 minutes, with roast potatoes, carrots and a gravy made from the pan. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 40g soft butter, thyme and salt. Toss 800g potatoes and 4 carrots in chunks with oil and salt and spread around the bird. Roast at 200C for 75 minutes, turning the veg once. Rest the chicken 10 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp plain flour into the pan juices, whisk in 300ml chicken stock and simmer until thick. Carve and serve with the roast veg and gravy.
Beef chuck stewed with red wine, onions and carrots
Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with onion, carrots and red wine until tender, served over buttery mash.
W: Chocolate cookies sandwiched around ice cream
Soft chocolate cookies baked at 180C for 10 minutes, cooled and sandwiched around a thick slab of vanilla ice cream, frozen an hour before serving.
K: Iceman frozen apple and mint spritz
Apple juice ice cubes in a glass with muddled mint and lime

Cloudy apple juice frozen into cubes, then topped with more apple, lime, muddled mint and soda water so it stays icy cold to the last sip. Freeze 400ml cloudy apple juice in ice cube trays overnight. Muddle a few mint leaves and a squeeze of lime in the bottom of 4 glasses. Fill with the apple ice cubes and a few thin green apple slices. Pour in 100ml cloudy apple juice each and top with 100ml soda water. Stir gently and finish with a mint sprig.

s.note: Bacon, potato and clam chowder with milk and cream
s.how: Fry 150g diced bacon, then soften a diced onion and 400g diced potatoes in butter. Add 2 cans of clams with their juice and 500ml milk and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in 150ml cream, season well and ladle into small cups with oyster crackers.

s.note: Red and green grapes frozen solid, served straight from the freezer
s.how: Wash 500g green grapes and 500g red grapes, pull from the stems and dry well. Spread on a lined tray and freeze for 3 hours until solid. Serve straight from the freezer in a cold bowl with a few mint leaves, like little marbles of ice.

m.note: Beef chuck stewed with red wine, onions and carrots
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions and 3 carrots, add the beef back with 375ml red wine and water to cover. Simmer for 3 hours until tender. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with plenty of butter, then spoon the stew on top.

w.note: Chocolate cookies sandwiched around ice cream
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar and an egg, then mix in 200g flour and 40g cocoa. Roll into balls, flatten and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Cool completely, then sandwich thick slabs of vanilla ice cream between pairs and freeze for an hour.

Fill with the apple ice cubes and a few thin green apple slices. Pour in 100ml cloudy apple juice each and top with 100ml soda water. Stir gently and finish with a mint sprig.
